description: Returns one field note in full by id (PC-..., DP-..., NH-...). Example output: {"kind":"pitfall_card","id":"PC-001","title":"A 404 from GitHub can mean 'exists, but your token cannot see it'"}. Arguments: id; optional format, "json" (default) or "markdown" for the note as one Markdown document (error strings, situation, cause, fix, verify, checked_on, source, link to its page). Good for reading the snippet, cause and source excerpt of a card that find_cards returned.

id.description: Record id, for example PC-001, DP-0064 or NH-001.
id.title: Id

name: get_card
